_comment: TC-34 (readme-refresh-trackb-and-followon-2026-09-01), SW-F fix. The durable, in-repo, git-tracked source of truth for the /readme-refresh (S-120) README structure -- previously only lived in a 1.8MB gitignored plan file. required_sections, check_function_count and section_shapes[].enforced_by are ALL independently, mechanically verified against the real code (readme_refresh_checks.py) by scripts/ci/checks/check_readme_template_contract_parity.py -- never hand-edit any of them without also re-running that check; it will fail loudly if this file drifts from the code, or if the code drifts from this file.

optional_sections.name: Additional Examples
optional_sections.rule: vacuously satisfied when absent -- required only when a product has enough real snippets to justify a dedicated section (a content-quality judgment call, not mechanically enforced). cells/cpp is the one portfolio product that legitimately has no such section.

section_order: required_sections lists the canonical order; Additional Examples, when present, sits between Quick Start and API Reference.

section_shapes._comment: TC-01 (readme-refresh-at-a-glance-retention-hardening-2026-09-02). The template contract used to stop at section NAMES; every section-BODY shape was either an incident-specific check or an unwritten convention held by imitation -- At a Glance's 'only the mermaid fence' shape appeared in no template, contract or rule and broke on 1 of 31 products (tex/python) while every gate passed. This list is the durable index of section-body invariants and the check that enforces each; the parity check asserts every enforced_by name exists as a real `def check_<name>(` in readme_refresh_checks.py, so an invariant can never again be documented without a mechanical backstop.

invariants.invariant: body is exactly one ```mermaid fence and nothing else (blank lines allowed); never a note, caveat or intro sentence before or after the diagram -- a whole-product limitation is a Scope and Limitations bullet, a per-capability caveat is an inline node label

a bulleted list of designed/declared limitations (or no list at all when none traces to a public source -- never invented filler), followed by a separate plain-prose Enterprise Edition paragraph; never prose-paragraph limitations, never a bulleted Enterprise mention
starts with the fixed template sentence (linked or unlinked form per the detected license file); real additional content may follow, free-form narration may not replace it
visible intro sentence naming real hub classes, then every module table row and curated member bullet inside a <details> block, unconditionally (no row-count threshold)
the exhaustive examples table is collapsed inside <details>; every worked example inside the disclosure carries its own real, unique, non-generic heading

### Required Package Dependencies always present (bullets or the fixed 'No required third-party package dependencies.' sentence); Optional/Development sub-headings omit only when their manifest bucket is empty; Native and System Requirements present whenever native_system is non-empty

check_function_count.note: This number drifts upward as missions land real new checks -- the parity check re-greps the real count on every run rather than trusting this file; a mismatch here is a doc-drift finding, not a code defect. 112 -> 114 on 2026-09-02 (check_at_a_glance_section_shape, check_content_unit_disposition_text_diff); 114 -> 115 the same day (check_cli_subcommand_coverage, ST-172); 115 -> 117 the same day (check_installation_matches_live_publication hard gate + check_published_version_matches_manifest advisory, readme-refresh-publication-state-hardening-2026-09-02); 117 -> 118 on 2026-09-03 (check_content_unit_reframe_fidelity, HARD gate -- readme-refresh-pdf-typescript-scale-hardening-2026-09-03 retention-audit follow-up); 118 -> 120 on 2026-09-04 (check_content_unit_cross_section_restatement + check_candidate_growth_ratio, both advisory -- readme-refresh-retention-vs-redundancy-hardening-2026-09-04, the symmetric anti-redundancy machinery the prior fix's own post-mortem found missing).
